Preserved entrypoints `read_candidate`, `read_profile`, `evaluate`. Stdlib only, no DevKit/Developer imports.

Verification observed:
- `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: 25 tests OK (12 visible + 13 contributor) in ~41s.
- `python3 -m compileall -q src tests`: OK.
- `tools/core_driver.py` with copied greeting/report fixtures and temp release JSON: ACCEPTED, exit 0; artifact `text-report.txt` 19 bytes, sha `48bb3ddb...`.

Repaired in-task: wheel filename must be exact for `pip install --no-index --no-deps`; fixed stderr capture missing append in bounded reader.

Uncertainty:
- Release malformed code uses `RELEASE_INVALID`; spec names no code.
- Profile unknown-field mapped to integrity, value violations to invalid; toolchain mismatch to untrusted.
- Hidden CSV/resource, receipt-tamper, timeout/output vectors not available locally; resource path verified with synthetic one-slot app, timeout/output verified via `run_bounded` unit probes only.
- Windows paths, remote `git://` source, and large-boundary cases not exercised.

Blocker: none open.
